courses.title: Running Usability Tests That Matter
courses.description: By the end of Running Usability Tests That Matter, you'll be able to apply usability testing confidently in UX Researcher work, with a working sense of where survey design fits alongside it. The course moves from core usability testing technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at survey design woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying usability testing to a real UX Researcher scenario
Practicing usability testing through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to survey design
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Research Synthesis in Practice
courses.description: Research Synthesis in Practice goes beyond the basics of research synthesis, for people already working toward a UX Researcher role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in research synthesis and want to go further.
learning_outcomes: Applying research synthesis to a real UX Researcher scenario
Practicing research synthesis through guided exercises
Building a short research synthesis exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Data Visualization Fundamentals
courses.description: Data Visualization Fundamentals is a short introduction to data visualization for people moving toward a UX Researcher role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show data visualization in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if data visualization is new to you.
learning_outcomes: Applying data visualization to a real UX Researcher scenario
Practicing data visualization through guided exercises
Building a short data visualization exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Usability Testing Essentials
alternates.description: Usability Testing Essentials walks you through the basics of usability testing, built for people new to UX Researcher work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of usability testing, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
learning_outcomes: Applying usability testing to a real UX Researcher scenario
Practicing usability testing through guided exercises
Building a short usability testing exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
